# Check: upstream tui-overlay-style-leak.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/tui-overlay-style-leak.test.ts

## Subject
TUI overlay compositing — regression tests that SGR style does not leak into subsequent lines when overlays or long content drop trailing resets.

## Upstream test count (approx)
2

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- does not leak styles when a trailing reset sits beyond the last visible column (no overlay case)
- does not leak styles when overlay slicing drops trailing SGR resets

## Upstream dependencies
Component, TUI, VirtualTerminal, Terminal from @xterm/headless

## Upstream notes
Italic style (\\x1b[3m / \\x1b[23m) is checked via getCellItalic() on xterm buffer cells. The Elixir equivalent will need a way to inspect effective SGR state per cell after compositing — may require a helper.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/overlay_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/tui_render_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/renderer_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/tui-overlay-style-leak.test.ts (2 tests)
Ours: overlay_test.exs (compositing unit tests) + tui_render_test.exs (integration renders) + test/support/virtual_terminal.ex (helper)

## Analysis

Upstream asserts a specific cell-level SGR invariant: after rendering an italic-styled line that spans the full width followed by an unstyled line, the cells on the unstyled line must NOT report `isItalic() == 1` in the backing terminal buffer. The test uses `getCellItalic(terminal, row, col)` which walks into `terminal.xterm.buffer.active.getLine(...).getCell(...).isItalic()` from @xterm/headless.

Two scenarios:
1. No overlay — trailing reset `\x1b[23m` sits beyond the last visible column.
2. With overlay — overlay slicing drops trailing SGR resets mid-line.

Our apps/octo_pi_tui/test/support/virtual_terminal.ex exposes no per-cell SGR attribute API (grep: no italic/sgr/attribute/cell match). Our overlay_test.exs verifies composite output as strings, not as attribute state; tui_render_test.exs compares viewport text, not attribute flags.

## UNMAPPED

- Regression: italic attribute does not leak to the line below when the trailing `\x1b[23m` reset sits beyond width (no overlay case).
- Regression: italic attribute does not leak to the line below when overlay compositing slices the base line and drops the trailing reset.

Both require new test-infrastructure (per-cell attribute inspection) before a port is possible.

## N/A / EXTRA

Our tests do cover overlay-composite output strings and general render flows, but none probe the SGR-attribute state of cells; these two upstream tests are therefore uncovered.

## Action

Compliance ticket will include two parts: (a) extend the VT helper with an attribute-inspection API; (b) port both tests.
